request.style: English, female gospel solo, soft piano, warm strings, gentle drum, acoustic guitar, reverent and majestic mood, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Twelve governors ruled over all Israel
Supplying provisions for the king and house
Each one held a month of the whole year
Ben-Hur in the hills of Ephraim
Ben-Deker in Makaz and Shaalbim
Ben-Hesed in Arubboth and Hepher

[Pre-Chorus]
In all the region of Naphath Dor
Ben-Abinadab held his place
A governor among the twelve names
Keeping the household in good order

[Chorus]
He had Solomon's daughter Taphath as his wife
A bond of loyalty and royal grace
In the district of Naphath Dor
Her name is remembered in that line

[Verse]
Baana son of Ahilud in Taanach
Megiddo and Beth Shan by Zarethan
From Beth Shan to Abel Meholah
Stretching out as far as Jokmeam
Solomon had many wives of royal birth
And three hundred concubines by his side

[Chorus]
He had Solomon's daughter Taphath as his wife
A bond of loyalty and royal grace
In the district of Naphath Dor
Her name is remembered in that line

[Chorus]
He had Solomon's daughter Taphath as his wife
A bond of loyalty and royal grace
In the district of Naphath Dor
Her name is remembered in that line
